P.name: Spider Queen
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Human Form:}} '''Elise''' gains one dormant ''Spiderling'' whenever she hits an enemy with an {{tip|ability}}, storing once per cast and up to {{pp|type = [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=]] ''Human Form's'' Rank|2 to 5 for 4}} at a time. She stores the maximum number of ''Spiderlings'' when the game starts and upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Spider Form:}} '''Elise's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pp|type = [[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] Spider Form's Rank|12 to 42 for 4|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|type=[[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] ''Spider Form's'' Rank|6 to 12 for 4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

Q.name: Neurotoxin
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' fires a toxin at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 160}} {{as|(+ 4% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}

Q.name: Venomous Bite
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' {{tip|dash|pounces}} at the target enemy with her fangs and bites them, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{rutngt|0.5}} from the start of the cast time. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.description2: If there are active ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' or ''{{ai|Volatile Spiderling|Elise|Volatile Spiderlings}}'' nearby, they will {{tip|dash}} alongside '''Elise''' to the target upon ''Venomous Bite's'' cast and reprioritize them.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ 8% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''missing''' health)|health}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}

W.name: Volatile Spiderling
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' summons an {{tip|untargetable}} venom-gorged spider that lasts for 3 seconds. The spider searches for nearby targets and crawls to them after a delay of {{fd|0.75}} seconds and otherwise crawls to the target location before doing so without incurring a delay, navigating its path upon encountering terrain.
W.description2: The spider gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} based on its proximity to the detected target. When the spider comes into contact with an enemy, or upon expiring otherwise, it instantly explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description3: The spider prioritizes the nearest enemy if it detects one before reaching the target location, and {{tip|champion|champions}} always if it detects one after doing so.

W.name: Skittering Frenzy
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' gain {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} for 3 seconds.
W.description3: ''Skittering Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Elise's''' [[basic attack]] timer. '''Elise''' loses Skittering Frenzy immediately when she switches to [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|Human Form|20px|link=Elise#Human Form|border]] [[Elise#Spider Form / Human Form|Human Form]].''

E.name: Cocoon
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' fires a web in the target direction, {{tip|stun|stunning}} the first enemy hit for a few seconds, during which they are also {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

E.name: Rappel
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' lift up into the air over {{fd|0.6}} seconds, immediately becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, and afterwards {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} for up to {{tt|{{fd|1.95}} seconds|Estimated}} and granting {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding {{tt|900 units|Pending for test}} for the duration.
E.description2: ''Rappel'' can be recast instantly on a target enemy within the duration, or without a target after {{tt|a delay|See notes}} for the duration, and does the latter automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' reappear and descend onto the ground over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming targetable and able to act again afterwards. Additionally, ''{{ais|Spider Queen|Elise}}'' bonuses are increased for 5 seconds.
E.description4: If the recast was used on a target enemy, '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' {{tip|blink|descend}} behind the target's location. Otherwise, she and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' will descend onto their current position without a target.
E.description5: ''Rappel's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

R.name: Spider Form
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Elise''' switches between her [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Human Form}} and [[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|[[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|melee}} basic attacks with {{sti|125 range}}, and access to her arachnid abilities. Additionally, she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health.
R.description4: {{sbc|[[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} basic attacks, and access to her human abilities. Additionally, she stores all active ''Spiderlings''.
R.description5: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16.

R.name: Human Form
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Elise''' switches between her [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Human Form}} and [[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|[[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|melee}} basic attacks with {{sti|125 range}}, and access to her arachnid abilities. Additionally, she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health.
R.description4: {{sbc|[[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} basic attacks, and access to her human abilities. Additionally, she stores all active ''Spiderlings''.
R.description5: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16.
